checkpoint_selection: minimum dev masked state NLL + T1 BCE + T2 NLL; earliest tie
state_mask: non-UNKNOWN and nonempty cutoff-valid evidence; per factor
t2_mask: resume true and original-goal first step not objectively completed
macro_classes: gold-supported classes; Q pooled by within-graph position
seed_aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation; not human-population CI
test_policy: evaluate once after all models/dev checkpoints fixed; no test selection
supplement_policy: v0.3 separate frozen-model diagnostic, no training or selection
